title: Mid-Autumn mooncakes
body: Families exchange boxes of lotus seed mooncakes at work and at home.
generationNotes: Grandparents insist on homemade; parents buy boxed sets.

title: Mid-Autumn mooncakes
body: Printed mooncakes ordered from apps, eaten on video calls with relatives abroad.
generationNotes: Young people send digital red envelopes instead.

title: Sunday ferry picnics
body: Families ride the river ferry and eat on the far bank.

title: Flood memorial walk
body: Each January people walk the old waterline with lanterns.
generationNotes: Children born after 2040 treat it as a festival.
